subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should Feishu source-message recall be an unconditional cancellation signal for all source-bound dispatches, including broadcast observer runs?
rationale: This changes a channel interaction from completing a received instruction to revoking it mid-run; tests can verify mechanics but cannot decide whether that is the intended product policy.

options.title: Approve Feishu cancellation semantics
options.body: Accept recall as cancellation for all dispatches bound to the recalled Feishu source and require current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the policy
options.body: Limit cancellation to a defined dispatch mode or add a documented opt-in if broadcast observers should continue after source recall.

options.title: Defer to the cross-channel design
options.body: Pause this Feishu-only behavior until the broader cancellation contract in the canonical issue has an approved cross-channel direction.

recommendation.title: Approve Feishu cancellation semantics
recommendation.body: Accept recall as cancellation for all dispatches bound to the recalled Feishu source and require current-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No named current-main Feishu owner was established from the supplied review context; the channel-area owner should make the policy call.
